title: The Terminal Made Me a Better Developer (And Not for the Reasons I Expected)
why_read: A personal essay on how using the terminal deepened the author's understanding of their system, pleasant but not technically novel.
analysis: The piece is a reflective, anecdotal account of a developer gradually shifting from GUI tools to the command line and gaining a better mental model of the filesystem and underlying OS mechanics along the way. It doesn't introduce new technical information or tools, functioning more as a motivational or relatable narrative for less experienced developers. Experienced engineers are unlikely to learn anything new from it.
